# EspDesktop Mac app and firmware compatibility

Use the Mac app and display firmware from the **same EspDesktop release**.

| Display | Mac | Mac app | Display firmware |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4-inch Guition ESP32-S3 4848S040 | Apple silicon, macOS 13 or newer | <span v-if="$frontmatter.matchedReleaseTag">{{ $frontmatter.matchedReleaseTag }}</span><span v-else>Choose a stable release</span> | <a v-if="$frontmatter.matchedReleaseTag" :href="$frontmatter.matchedReleaseUrl">{{ $frontmatter.matchedReleaseTag }} firmware and release assets</a><span v-else>Choose firmware from the same release</span> |

For an older version, find the matching Mac DMG and 4848S040 firmware in [GitHub releases](https://github.com/jtenniswood/espdesktop/releases). See [how to update or roll back](/settings/system#update-the-mac-app-and-display-together).

## Protocol and layout details

Companion and firmware currently use protocol 4 and capability version 7.

Supported display: guition-esp32-s3-4848s040.

Install firmware and Companion from the same release. Saved panel configuration remains version 2. Protocol compatibility is separate from saved configuration.

Each release includes companion-compatibility.json with the source revision, contract digest, and SHA-256 checksums of the matching firmware and Mac artifacts. Automated tests do not assert physical device validation. Independent Mac/firmware release delivery is not yet enabled.
